arabic_text: وَلَوْ دَلَّ مَخْلُوقٌ مَخْلُوقاً مِنْ نَفْسِهِ عَلَى مِثْلِ الَّذِيْ دَلَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عِبَادَكَ مِنْكَ كَانَ مَوْصُوْفَاً بالإحْسَان وَمَنْعُوتاً بِالامْتِثَال ومحمُوداً بكلِّ لِسَان،
transliteration: wa law dallā makhluqun makhluqan min nafsihi ʿalā mithli allathī dalaltā ʿalayhi ʿibādaka minka kāna mawṣūfan bil-iḥsān wa man'ūtan bil-imitthāl wa maḥmūdan bikulli lisān
english_text: Were any creature himself to direct another creature to the like of that to which Thou Thyself hast directed Thy servants, he would be described by beneficence, qualified by kindness, and praised by every tongue.

arabic_text: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ مَا وُجِدَ فِي حَمْدِكَ مَذْهَبٌ، وَمَا بَقِيَ لِلْحَمْدِ لَفْظٌ تُحْمَدُ بِهِ وَمَعْنىً يَنْصَرفُ إلَيْهِ
transliteration: falaka al-ḥamdu mā wujida fī ḥamdika maḏhabun wamā baqiya lil-ḥamdi lafẓun tuḥmadu bihī wamaʿnan yanṣarifu ilayhī
english_text: So to Thee belongs praise as long as there is found a way to praise Thee and as long as there remains for praising words by which Thou may be praised and meanings which may be spent in praise!

arabic_text: يَـا مَنْ تَحَمَّدَ إلَى عِبَـادِهِ بِالإِحْسَـانِ وَالْفَضْل، وَغَمَرَهُمْ بِالْمَنِّ وَالطَّوْلِ،
transliteration: yā man taḥammada ilā ʿibādih bi-l-'iḥsāni wa-l-faḍl wa ghamarahum bil manni wattaawli
english_text: O He who shows Himself praiseworthy to His servants through beneficence and bounty, flooding them with kindness and graciousness!

arabic_text: مَا أَفْشَى فِيْنَا نِعْمَتَكَ وَأَسْبَغَ عَلَيْنَا مِنَّتَكَ، وَأَخَصَّنَا بِبِرِّكَ
transliteration: mā afshā fīnā niʿmatka wa asbağa ʿalaynā minnatka wa-akhassana bi-birrika
english_text: How much Thy favour has been spread about among us, Thy kindness lavished upon us, and Thy goodness singled out for us!

arabic_text: هَدْيَتَنَا لِدِيْنِكَ الَّـذِي اصْطَفَيْتَ، وَمِلَّتِـكَ الَّتِي ارْتَضَيْتَ، وَسَبِيلِكَ الَّذِي سَهَّلْتَ، وَبَصَّرْتَنَا الزُّلْفَةَ لَدَيْكَ وَالوُصُولَ إلَى كَـرَامَتِكَ.
transliteration: hadīyatunā li-dīnika alladhī iṣtafayta wa millatika allati artadayta wa sabeelika alladhee sahhalt wa baṣṣartanā aż-żulfa taʿaynak wal-wuṣūla ilā karamatik
english_text: Thou hast guided us to Thy religion which Thou hast chosen, Thy creed with which Thou art pleased, and Thy path which Thou hast made smooth, and Thou hast shown us proximity to Thee and arrival at Thy generosity!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَأَنْتَ جَعَلْتَ مِنْ صَفَـايَـا تِلْكَ الْوَظَائِفِ وَخَصَائِصِ تِلْكَ الْفُرُوضِ شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ الَّذِي اخْتَصَصْتَهُ مِنْ سَائِرِ الشُّهُورِ، وَتَخَيَّرْتَهُ مِن جَمِيعِ الأزْمِنَةِ وَالدُّهُورِ،
transliteration: allāhumma wa anta jaʿaltamin safāyā tilka alwaẓāʾif wa khassā'is tilka al-furūḍ shahr ramadan al-ladhi ikhtassahu min sa'ir al-shuhur wa-takhayyartahu min jami' al-azminati wa ad-duhur
english_text: O God, Thou hast appointed among the choicest of those duties and the most special of those obligations the month of Ramadan, which Thou hast singled out from other months, chosen from among all periods and eras,

arabic_text: وَآثَرْتَهُ عَلَى كُلِّ أَوْقَاتِ السَّنَةِ بِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ وَالنُّورِ، وَضَاعَفْتَ فِيهِ مِنَ الإيْمَانِ، وَفَرَضْتَ فِيْهِ مِنَ الصِّيَامِ،
transliteration: wa ʾathartahu ʿalaa kulli awqaatis-sannah bimā anzalta fīhi min al-qur'āni wa al-nūr waḍāʿafta fīhi min al-īmāni wa faraḍta fīhi mina al-ṣiyām
english_text: and preferred over all times of the year through the Qur'an and the Light which Thou sent down within it, the faith which Thou multiplied by means of it, the fasting which Thou obligated therein,

arabic_text: وَرَغَّبْتَ فِيهِ مِنَ القِيَامِ، وَأَجْلَلْتَ فِيهِ مِنْ لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ الَّتِي هِيَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَلْفِ شَهْر،
transliteration: wa-raghabta fiihi min al-qiyam wa-ajlaltu fīhi min laylati al-qadr al-latī hiya khayrun min alfi shahr
english_text: the standing in prayer which Thou encouraged at its time, and the Night of Decree which Thou magnified therein, the night which is "better than a thousand months" (97:3).

arabic_text: ثُمَّ آثَرْتَنَا بِهِ عَلَى سَائِرِ الأُمَمِ وَاصْطَفَيْتَنَا بِفَضْلِهِ دُوْنَ أَهْلِ الْمِلَلِ،
transliteration: thumma athartana bihi 'ala sa'iri al-umam wa-aṣṭafaytanā bifadlihi dūna ahli al-milal
english_text: Through it Thou hast preferred us over the other communities and through its excellence Thou hast chosen us to the exclusion of the people of the creeds.

arabic_text: فَصُمْنَا بِأَمْرِكَ نَهَارَهُ، وَقُمْنَا بِعَوْنِكَ لَيْلَهُ مُتَعَرِّضِينَ بِصِيَامِهِ وَقِيَامِهِ لِمَا عَرَّضْتَنَا لَهُ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ، وَتَسَبَّبْنَا إلَيْـهِ مِنْ مَثُوبَتِكَ،
transliteration: faṣumna biamrika nahārahu wa qumnā biʿawnika laylahu mutʿarraḍīna bi-ṣiyāmihi wa qiyāmihi limā ʿarraḍtanā lahū min raḥmatika wa tasabbabnā ilayhi min mathūbatika
english_text: We fasted by Thy command in its daylight, we stood in prayer with Thy help in its night, presenting ourselves by its fasting and its standing to the mercy which Thou hast held up before us, and we found through it the means to Thy reward.

arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ الْمَليءُ بِمَا رُغِبَ فِيهِ إلَيْكَ، الْجَوَادُ بِمـا سُئِلْتَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ، الْقَـرِيبُ إلَى مَنْ حَـاوَلَ قُرْبَكَ،
transliteration: wa-anta al-malīʾu bimā rughiba fīhi ilayka al-jawādu bimā suʾilta min faḍlika al-qarībū ʾilā man ḥāwala qurbaka
english_text: And Thou art full of what is sought from Thee, munificent with what is asked of Thy bounty, and near to him who strives for Thy nearness.

arabic_text: وَقَدْ أَقَامَ فِينَا هَذَا الشَّهْرُ مَقَامَ حَمْد وَصَحِبَنَا صُحْبَةَ مَبْرُور، وَأَرْبَحَنَا أَفْضَلَ أَرْبَاحِ الْعَالَمِينَ،
transliteration: wa qad aqama feenaa haadha ash-shahr maqaam hamd waṣaḥibana ṣuḥbata mabrūr wa-arbaḥanā afḍala arbaḥi al-ʿālamīn
english_text: This month stood among us in a standing place of praise, accompanied us with the companionship of one approved, and profited us with the most excellent profit of the world's creatures.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ قَدْ فَارَقَنَا عِنْدَ تَمَامِ وَقْتِهِ وَانْقِطَاعِ مُدَّتِهِ وَوَفَاءِ عَدَدِهِ،
transliteration: thumma qad faraqnaa ʿinda tamami waqtihii wa anqitaai muddatihii wa wafaai ʿadadihii
english_text: Then it parted from us at the completion of its time, the end of its term, and the fulfilment of its number.

arabic_text: فَنَحْنُ مُوَدِّعُوهُ وِدَاعَ مَنْ عَزَّ فِرَاقُهُ عَلَيْنَا وَغَمَّنَا وَأَوْحَشَنَا انْصِرَافُهُ عَنَّا وَلَزِمَنَا لَهُ الذِّمَامُ الْمَحْفُوظُ، وَالْحُرْمَةُ الْمَرْعِيَّةُ، وَالْحَقُّ الْمَقْضِيُّ،
transliteration: fanahnu muwaddiʿūhu widāʿa man ʿazza firāquhu ʿalaynā wa ghammanna wa awhashna insiraafuhu anna walazimana lahu al dhimamu al mahfuzhu wal-ḥurmatu-l-marʿiyyatu, wal-ḥaqqul-maqḍiyyu
english_text: So we bid farewell to it with the farewell of one whose parting pains us, whose leaving fills us with gloom and loneliness, and to whom we have come to owe a safeguarded claim, an observed inviolability, and a discharged right.

arabic_text: فَنَحْنُ قَائِلُونَ: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا شَهْرَ اللهِ الأكْبَرَ، وَيَا عِيْدَ أَوْلِيَائِهِ.
transliteration: fa-nahnu qa'iloon: assalamu 'alayka yā shahr allāhi l-akbar, wa yā ʿīda awliyāʾihi
english_text: We say: Peace be upon thee, O greatest month of God! O festival of His friends!

arabic_text: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَـا أكْرَمَ مَصْحُـوب مِنَ الأوْقَاتِ،
transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalayka yā akram maṣḥūb min al-awqāt
english_text: Peace be upon thee, O most noble of accompanying times!

arabic_text: وَيَا خَيْرَ شَهْر فِي الأيَّامِ وَالسَّاعَاتِ.
transliteration: wayā khayra shahr fī al-ʾayyām wa al-sāʿāt
english_text: O best of months in days and hours!

arabic_text: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ شَهْر قَرُبَتْ فِيهِ الآمالُ وَنُشِرَتْ فِيهِ الأَعْمَالُ.
transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalayka min shahr qarubat fīhi al-āmāl wa nushirat fihi al-aʿmāl
english_text: Peace be upon thee, month in which expectations come near and good works are scattered about!

arabic_text: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ قَرِين جَلَّ قَدْرُهُ مَوْجُوداً، وَأَفْجَعَ فَقْدُهُ مَفْقُوداً، وَمَرْجُوٍّ آلَمَ فِرَاقُهُ.
transliteration: assalamu ʿalayka min qarīn jalla qadruhu mawjūdā wa'afja'a faqduhu mafqoodan, wa marjuwwin alama firaaquhu
english_text: Peace be upon thee, comrade who is great in worth when found and who torments through absence when lost, anticipated friend whose parting gives pain!

arabic_text: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَلِيف آنَسَ مُقْبِلاً فَسَرَّ وَأَوْحَشَ مُنْقَضِياً فَمَضَّ.
transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalayka min ʾalīf ʾānsa muqbilan fasarra wa-awḥaša munqaḍiyān famaḍḍa
english_text: Peace be upon thee, familiar who brought comfort in coming, thus making happy, who left loneliness in going, thus giving anguish!

arabic_text: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ مُجَاوِر رَقَّتْ فِيهِ الْقُلُوبُ، وَقَلَّتْ فِيهِ الذُّنُوبُ.
transliteration: as-salāmu ʿalayka min mujāwir raqqat fīhi al-qulūbu, wa qallat fīhi al-dhunūbu
english_text: Peace be upon thee, neighbour in whom hearts became tender and sins became few!

arabic_text: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ نَاصِر أَعَانَ عَلَى الشَّيْطَانِ وَصَاحِب سَهَّلَ سُبُلَ الإحْسَانِ.
transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalayka min nāṣir aʿāna ʿalā al-shayṭān wa ṣāḥib sahhala subul al-iḥsān
english_text: Peace be upon thee, helper who aided against Satan, companion who made easy the paths of good-doing!

arabic_text: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مَا أكْثَرَ عُتَقَاءَ اللهِ فِيكَ
transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalayka mā akthara ʿutāqāʾa allāhi fīka
english_text: Peace be upon thee - How many became freedmen of God within thee!

arabic_text: وَمَا أَسْعَدَ مَنْ رَعَى حُرْمَتَكَ بكَ!.
transliteration: wa mā asʿada man raʿā ḥurmataka bika!
english_text: How happy those who observed the respect due to thee!

arabic_text: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مَا كَانَ أَمْحَاكَ لِلذُّنُوبِ،
transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalayka mā kāna amḥāka lil-dhunūb
english_text: Peace be upon thee - How many the sins thou erased!

arabic_text: وَأَسْتَرَكَ لأَِنْوَاعِ الْعُيُوبِ!
transliteration: wa astarak li-anwāʿi al-ʿuyūb!
english_text: How many the kinds of faults thou covered over!

arabic_text: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مَا كَانَ أَطْوَلَكَ عَلَى الْمُجْرِمِينَ،
transliteration: assalamu ʿalayka mā kāna aṭwalaka ʿalā al-mujrimīn
english_text: Peace be upon thee - How drawn out wert thou for the sinners!

arabic_text: وَأَهْيَبَكَ فِي صُدُورِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ!
transliteration: wa 'ahyabaka fi suduri al-mu'mineen!
english_text: How awesome wert thou in the hearts of the faithful!

arabic_text: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ شَهْر لا تُنَافِسُهُ الأيَّامُ.
transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalayka min shahrin lā tunāfisu-hu al-ayyāmu
english_text: Peace be upon thee, month with which no days compete!

arabic_text: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ شَهْر هُوَ مِنْ كُلِّ أَمْر سَلاَمٌ.
transliteration: assalamu ʿalayka min shahr huwa min kulli amrin salam.
english_text: Peace be upon thee, month which is peace in all affairs!
